scripts.text:
[Guide]
Hello~
This guide wants to be the one to take you to a special place.
What kind of place is that?
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
你好~
這位嚮導想帶你去一個特別的地方。
那是什麼樣的地方呢？

scripts.text:
[Guide]
It's a place full of mysterious items to collect and sell.
To buy stuff there you need special money.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
那裡充滿了神秘物品，可以收集也可以出售。
在那裡買東西需要特殊的貨幣。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
So, are you ready to go there?
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
那麼，你準備好去了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Okay~
But don't get frustrated.
There's always more chances~
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
好的~
不過別灰心。
機會總是有的~

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Yeah~ You're really ready.
Well then, get some good stuff~
Oops, I forgot. When you come out be sure to come back here.
Rember this~
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
嗯~ 你真的準備好了。
那麼，去挑選好東西吧~
哎呀，我忘了。出來的時候記得回來這裡。
記住這一點~

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Have you had a good time?
Thank you very much for using our item mall.
We will continue to bring you valuable items.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
你玩得開心嗎？
非常感謝你使用我們的物品商城。
我們會繼續為你帶來珍貴的物品。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Would you like to return from where you came from?
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
你想回到你來的地方嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Guide]
There are still more things to see.
Have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
還有更多東西可以看。
祝你玩得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Thank you for coming.
I'll send you back from where you came from.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
謝謝你的光臨。
我會把你送回你來的地方。

scripts.text:
[Macaroon]
Welcome!
Today doesn't come every day!
Things to see today~ Voila!
You can only exchange with {0}!
Feel free to choose!
scripts.translation:
[馬卡龍]
歡迎光臨！
今天可不是天天都有哦！
今天可以看到的~ 看這裡！
只能用{0}兌換哦！
請隨意挑選！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Basta]
I have taken over the work of Mighty Hammer, Brock and the Shadow Blacksmith. I will be busy from now on.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巴斯塔]
我接手了巨力鐵錘、布羅克和影子鐵匠的工作。從現在開始我會很忙的。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Mighty Hammer]
If it is about refining, ask Basta. I am retired.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 巨力鐵錘]
如果是關於精煉的事，請去問巴斯塔。我已經退休了。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Brock]
I am retired now. If it is about refining, make a request to Basta over there.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 布羅克]
我現在退休了。如果是關於精煉的事，請去那邊找巴斯塔。

scripts.text:
[Jeremy]
Hello cutie~
I would like you to call me Head Stylist Jeremy.
scripts.translation:
[傑瑞米]
你好呀，小可愛~
請叫我首席造型師傑瑞米。

scripts.text: Change style
scripts.translation: 改變造型

scripts.text: End conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Jeremy]
My shop is always open, so please come back anytime.
scripts.translation:
[傑瑞米]
我的店隨時都開著，歡迎隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Stylist]
Hey, I'm Kaniki.
I'm here to start a new
trend by introducing my
special new hairstyles!
Give me a ^FF0000New Style Coupon^000000,
and I'll change your hair~
scripts.translation:
[造型師]
嘿，我是卡尼基。
我要通過介紹我特別的新發型來引領新潮流！
給我一張^FF0000新造型券^000000，
我就幫你換髮型~

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
I have two special
hairstyles for men, the
Emergency Heal Perm
and the Aura Blade Cut.
and aura blade cut.
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
我有兩款男士特別髮型，
分別是緊急治癒燙和靈氣劍切。
還有靈氣劍切。

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
This is the Emergency
Heal Perm. It's a brand
new style I invented recently.
What do you think? Cool, huh?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
這是緊急治癒燙。這是我最近發明的一款全新發型。
你覺得怎麼樣？很酷吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
Now this is the Aura
Blade Cut. You haven't
seen anything like it
before, haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
這是靈氣劍切。你以前肯定沒見過這種髮型，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
I have two new hairstyles for
women, the Assumptio Perm
and the Soul Changer Cut.
Do you want to see how
these styles look?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
我有兩款女士新發型，
分別是聖母之祈福燙和靈魂變換切。
你想看看這些髮型的效果嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
This is the Assumptio
Perm. It'd really good
on you, wouldn't it?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
這是聖母之祈福燙。你留這個髮型一定很好看，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
Next is the Soul
Changer Cut. What do
you think? Isn't it nice?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
接下來是靈魂變換切。你覺得怎麼樣？很不錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
Have you decided
if you'd like me to
change your hairstyle?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
你決定好要不要讓我幫你換髮型了嗎？

scripts.text: Change Hairstyle
scripts.translation: 更換髮型

scripts.text: Don't Change
scripts.translation: 不更換

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
Really? Oh, that's too bad.
Well, if you ever change your
mind about updating your
hairstyle, come back
and let me know, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
真的嗎？哎呀，那太遺憾了。
如果您之後改變主意，想更新發型的話，
記得回來告訴我哦。

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
I'm sorry, but I can
only provide my hairstyling
service if you bring a New
Style Coupon. Please come
back to me after you manage to
get one of those coupons, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
很抱歉，只有持有“新發型券”才能使用我的美髮服務。
請您拿到那種券後再來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
Great, you brought
a New Style Coupon!
Alright, which hairstyle
did you want to have?
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
太好了，您帶來了新發型券！
那麼，您想換成哪種髮型呢？

scripts.text: Emergency Heal Perm
scripts.translation: 緊急治癒燙

scripts.text: Aura Blade Cut
scripts.translation: 靈氣劍剪

scripts.text: Assumptio Perm
scripts.translation: 聖母之祈福燙

scripts.text: Soul Changer Cut
scripts.translation: 靈魂變換剪

scripts.text:
[Kaniki]
There--! It's done!
How do you like your
new hair? Well, I hope
to see you again. Take care!
scripts.translation:
[卡尼基]
好了——！完成了！
您覺得新發型怎麼樣？
希望下次還能為您服務。再見！
